title: Simple Character Counter Using Angular 19
tagline: A solution to the Character counter challenge on Frontend Mentor, built with Angular 19. 🔤
why: Frontend Mentor challenges help you improve your coding skills by building realistic projects.

sections.title: The challenge
body: This is a solution to the [Character counter challenge on Frontend Mentor](https://www.frontendmentor.io/challenges/character-counter-znSgeWs_i6).
bullets: Analyze the character, word, and sentence counts for their text
Exclude/Include spaces in their character count
Receive a warning message if their text exceeds their character limit
See the approximate reading time of their text
Analyze the letter density of their text
View the optimal layout for the interface depending on their device's screen size
See hover and focus states for all interactive elements on the page
